scope: Transactional writer and typed metadata encoder; no GGUF importer or inference integration claim.
contracts: Rectangular GGML tensors, multiple blocks/tensors, typed metadata and generated-file hash roundtrip through WeightReader
Two concurrent finish calls have exactly one winner and one DestinationExists failure
Invalid operation poisons writer; finish cannot publish and Drop/abort clean temporaries
Per-weight bits/depth/steps, block terms/bytes, resident accounting and output limits reject before publication
Inclusive output budget accepts exact size and rejects one byte less
All scalar and array metadata types preserve numeric ranges and IEEE bit patterns
Cumulative certificate replay budget crosses blocks and localizes the second weight
Corrupt spool fails payload integrity validation before publication
Duplicate metadata/tensor names are rejected without a partial destination
publication: Same-directory hard_link, no overwriting rename fallback; final file fully verified before linking; spool cleanup before commit; final temporary link cleanup best-effort after commit
limitations: No power-loss durability guarantee or filesystem portability campaign; unsupported hard links return a typed IO error.
Memory accounting is conservative, not measured process RSS.
The earlier full mutation campaign does not cover this newly added writer.
